trajectory_summary: The call opens with friction that the rep defuses well using an action-based explanation, then moves cleanly through verification and qualifiers. It stalls on bill collection: the customer has no physical bill or online account handy, and after an unexplained multi-minute gap the customer proposes ending the call and calling back later. The rep accepted this without locking a specific callback time, converting what could have been a firm follow-up into a soft, self-directed promise from the customer.
outcome_dispute: This call should not be read as a firm callback or booked appointment. The customer said 'we can do this thing tomorrow... I can call you back if that's okay with you,' and the rep responded by promising to text him rather than proposing a specific time to call back or setting an appointment. No day or time was locked for either a callback or a closer appointment — this is closer to no_appointment/soft callback than a scheduled outcome.
